##### **Important Safety Instructions**

When operating any electrical appliance, basic precautions should always be followed for safety.
WARNING: To reduce risk of electrical fire, electric shock or injury:

* Carefully read the entire contents of this manual.
* Do not use outdoors or on wet surfaces.
* Do not use the purifier in areas of extreme heat or in the presence of
  flammable gas.
* Do not handle the wires or appliance with wet hands.
* Do not use damaged or uninsulated wires. If the purifier is not working
  properly, call our Customer Excellence team (806) 373-7788.
  WARNING: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHOCK. CAN CAUSE INJURY OR DEATH. DISCONNECT PURIFIER FROM POWER SUPPLY BE-FORE SERVICING.
* Store and transport at -4˚F - 180˚F and 10% - 90% humidity (non-condensing).
* Do not place the purifier in direct sunlight.
* This product is not recommended for users with a lack of physical,
  sensory, mental abilities, experience or lack of knowledge.
* To prevent electrical shock, please remove the power plug before
  maintaining or moving the purifier.
* Please do not clean the appliance with any type of acid-based solu-
  tions.
* Do not block the air inlets or outlets.
* Make sure the purifier is used within the voltage range of 110-
  240VAC, 50/60Hz.
* It is strictly prohibited to rinse the appliance with water. Do not use
  the purifier near water sources or volatile flammable items to prevent shock.
* This product is not a toy, hence it is prohibited for children to play with the purifier.
* Do not sit or stand on the purifier. Do not use the purifier when it is shaking or tilting.
* If the purifier is operating abnormally, please unplug the power and contact the manufacturer.
* When cleaning, use a soft, dry cloth to gently wipe the purifier. Use a small soft brush to softly clean the air outlets.

##### **Assembly**

1. Ensure both filters are fully seated inside the air purifier. They may have moved during shipping and the purifier will not turn on if they are not fully inserted.
2. Slide the top cover towards the back of the purifier and then press down on the two circles in the front to activate the push latches. Your air purifier won’t power on if the top cover is not seated correctly.
3. Slide the four legs over the rails in each corner. Then secure the legs with the included Phillips Head screws by inserting one screw in lowest hole of each leg.

After the purifier is plugged in, the power icon lights up and the machine remains in standby state. Press the power button, the purifier will beep and turn on. All lights will dim slightly after three minutes of inactivity.
**Purifier / UV / Ionizer Power Control** The purifier automatically powers up in AUTO mode when the power button is pressed. Additional presses will turn off the Ionizer, UV LEDs or the air purifier.
**Timer** Press the Timer button to set the shutdown timer. It can be cycled between 1H-12H. Once the Timer is set, the button will flash. Once the time is up, the purifier will power down and enter standby mode.
**Fan Speed** Press the Fan Speed button, the fan speed indicator will light up, the purifier will beep, and the fan speed will change.
**Night Mode / Child Lock** Press the Night Mode button for 3 seconds to lock the control panel and turn off all lights. Hold it down 3 seconds again and the control panel will unlock. Tap any button while Night Mode is activated to view the purifiers current control status.
![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
**Toggle** Press the Toggle button to check the remaining filter life. The display will show a countdown of remaining filter life from 100% - 0%. When there are less the 60 hours of remaining filter life, the (%) icon will begin flashing to indicate it’s time to replace the filters. After you replace the filters, hold down the Toggle button for 3 seconds to reset the filter life countdown. The air purifier will use a combination or run time, fan speed and air quality to determine the remaining filter life. This ensures your purifier always runs a peak performance.
**Auto Mode** Pressing the AUTO button will activate or deactivate AUTO mode. When AUTO mode is active, the AUTO button will flash and the fan speed will automatically adjust according to your air quality. If your air quality decreases the fans will increase in speed. As your air quality improves the fans will wait 30 seconds and then decrease in speed. The fan speed will change according the table below.

##### **Operation**

Air Quality Indicator Ring Particles (µg/m3) Fan Speed
Excellent Green 0-75 Speed 1
Moderate Orange 76-150 Speed 3
Poor Red >150 Speed 4
**WiFi and Air Oasis App** To connect your air purifier to the Air Oasis App please visit the Apple or Google Play Store and download the Air Oasis Home app. Hold down the AUTO button until you hear two beeps and the WiFi icon begins to flash. Follow the instructions on the app to finish pairing your air purifier.
Once pairing is complete, the WiFi icon will remain solid.
For those sensitive to WiFi or for use in buildings that don’t allow any connected devices, the WiFi module is removable. Once removed, the WiFi icon will remain off.

##### **Operation**

WiFi Chip Removal

1. Unplug the air purifier from it’s power source.
2. Remove the top cover by pressing down and then lifting up.
3. Unscrew and remove the WiFi cover.
4. Lift the WiFi chip out of the purifier and unplug it.
   Please dispose of the WiFi chip properly by following local disposal laws or ship it back to Air Oasis for proper disposal.

##### **Filter Replacement**

1. Turn off the purifier and unplug it from the power source.
2. Install new filters.
3. Remove the top cover by pressing down and then lifting up.
4. Close the top cover.
5. Remove the old filters by pulling upwards.
6. The replacement is complete.
   Note: Long press the toggle button for 3 seconds to reset the filter replacement countdown.

##### **Troubleshooting**

For maximum air cleaning efficiency, the air inlets and outlets should be kept at least four inches from walls or other occlusions when in operation.
Attention: Close doors and windows when using the purifier.
**Air Purifier Not Turning On** Ensure the following:

* The power cord is not loose or broken and is plugged into the power source.
* The filters are fully inserted.
* The lid is fully closed.
* The power button has been pressed.
  **Odors From the Air Purifier** Ensure the following:
* There is not debris buildup. Your purifier requires regular filter replacements.
* Is this a new purifier or new filters? Most people notice a difference in how the air smells within minutes because new filters more efficiently remove existing smells and odors.
  **Poor Performance** Ensure the following:
* The purifier is in a space with good air circulation and ventilation. Your purifier requires proper air flow to cycle through and clean your air.
* Neither the air inlet nor outlet are obstructed.
* You have replaced the filters on schedule.
* You have the right size of air purifier for the room, occupancy and
  contaminant load.
